implement.name: Design system first
implement.summary: Read the identity and the tokens before writing anything a user looks at; never inline a value

review.name: Drift and mutedness weigh the same
review.summary: An invented value and a consistent interface with no identity are both findings

review.name: Design audit
review.summary: Measure an interface against the system — the drift column and the mutedness column

audit.name: Design audit
audit.summary: Take stock of an interface against the design system, drift and mutedness on equal footing

convene.name: Designer
convene.summary: The standing role that judges what a user actually sees — route interface questions to it
